state.bill_title_hebrew: הצעת חוק יסודות התקציב (תיקון - מניעת תמיכה במוסדות המסיתים להשתמטות), התשפ"ו-2025

main_issue.instructions: Which specific policy dispute is the Israeli bill in `bill_title_hebrew` mainly about?

criteria.haredi_draft: Military conscription of Haredi (ultra-Orthodox) yeshiva students, draft exemptions and sanctions on draft evasion (גיוס חרדים, שירות ביטחון, השתמטות)
criteria.soldier_reservist_benefits: Benefits and rights for soldiers, reservists and discharged soldiers: tax breaks, grants, priority, land, daycare (מילואים, חיילים משוחררים)
criteria.terror_punitive_measures: Harsher measures against terrorists and their families: deportation, revoking citizenship, not returning bodies, minimum sentences (מחבלים, גירוש, שלילת אזרחות)
criteria.death_penalty_terrorists: Death penalty for terrorists (עונש מוות למחבלים)
criteria.security_detainee_rights: Rights of security detainees and suspects: lawyer access, detention extensions, prison conditions (עצור בעבירת ביטחון)
criteria.terror_victims: Rights and compensation for victims of terror and their families (נפגעי פעולות איבה, נפגעי טרור)
criteria.sovereignty_annexation: Applying Israeli sovereignty / annexation in Judea and Samaria or specific settlements (החלת ריבונות)
criteria.judea_samaria_other: Other Judea and Samaria (West Bank) measures: land purchase, settlement status, terminology, disengagement law (יהודה והשומרון)
criteria.palestinian_state_pa: Palestinian Authority and Palestinian state: PA funds linked to terror, recognition of a Palestinian state, humanitarian aid, UNRWA (הרשות הפלסטינית, אונר"א)
criteria.nation_state_equality: Nation-State Law, Jewish identity of the state versus civic equality in Basic Laws (חוק הלאום, שוויון, מגילת העצמאות)
criteria.judicial_overhaul: Judicial overhaul: Supreme Court powers, judicial selection, override clause, legal advisers (בית המשפט העליון, מינוי שופטים, פסקת התגברות)
criteria.government_structure_term_limits: Government structure and accountability: PM term limits, ministers' qualifications, immunity, state commissions of inquiry (הגבלת כהונה, ועדת חקירה ממלכתית)
criteria.police_political_control: Political control over the police and investigations, police powers and surveillance (משטרה, חקירה, רוגלות)
criteria.disqualifying_candidates: Disqualifying candidates or removing MKs who support terror or armed struggle (פסילת מועמדים, הדחת חבר כנסת)
criteria.ngo_foreign_funding: Regulating NGOs and foreign government funding (עמותות, ישות מדינית זרה)
criteria.media_public_broadcaster: Media regulation, the public broadcaster Kan, foreign broadcasters such as Al Jazeera (תאגיד השידור, כאן, אל-ג'זירה)
criteria.civil_marriage: Civil marriage and divorce outside the rabbinate (נישואים אזרחיים)
criteria.rabbinate_religious_services: Rabbinate and religious services: chief rabbis, city rabbis, conversion, religious councils (רבנות, גיור, שירותי דת)
criteria.haredi_education_core: Core curriculum and funding of Haredi education (לימודי ליבה, חינוך חרדי)
criteria.lgbt_rights: LGBT rights, conversion therapy bans (להט"ב, טיפול המרה)
criteria.women_representation: Women's representation and gender equality in politics and public bodies (ייצוג נשים)
criteria.arab_society: Arab and Druze citizens: planning and housing in Arab towns, Arabic language, crime in Arab society (חברה ערבית, דרוזים)
criteria.illegal_weapons_crime: Illegal weapons, organized crime, protection racketeering (נשק בלתי חוקי, ארגוני פשיעה, דמי חסות)
criteria.immigration_migrants: Immigration, asylum seekers, foreign workers, family reunification (מסתננים, עובדים זרים, איחוד משפחות)
criteria.cost_of_living: Cost of living: food prices, monopolies, consumer protection (יוקר המחיה, מחירים)
criteria.welfare_benefits: Social welfare benefits: child allowances, unemployment, disability, elderly, poverty (קצבאות, ביטוח לאומי)
criteria.frontline_communities: Support for frontline and border communities and the home front after October 7 (קו העימות, עוטף עזה, מיגון)
criteria.health_periphery: Health services and the gap between periphery and center (בריאות, פריפריה)
criteria.technical_amendment: Technical or procedural amendment with no clear policy dispute
